Patch Set 25:

Hi Ratan, Chinmay -- I've been building the bmcweb ComponentIntegrity frontend (88828) that consumes this backend, so I looked into why CI is red here and built the stack locally against current master. Two findings:

1. This change (80267): the CI failure is an undeclared meson option.
   meson.build calls get_option('coverage'), but meson.options only declares
   'tests', so meson setup aborts before compiling anything:

     meson.build:97:3: ERROR: Option coverage does not exist.

   Fix -- add to meson.options:

     option('coverage', type: 'boolean', value: false,
            description: 'Enable the coverage-html custom target')

2. Heads-up for the rebase: the stack is now stale vs current
   phosphor-dbus-interfaces. With the option added, setup passes but the build
   then fails in requester/utils/mapper.cpp -- the ObjectMapper client dropped
   the get_sub_tree_t alias, and get_sub_tree() now returns
   std::map<std::string, std::map<std::string, std::vector<std::string>>>:

     mapper.cpp:24: error: 'get_sub_tree_t' is not a member of 'Mapper'

   Fix:
     - #include <map>
     - using SubTreeType =
           std::map<std::string, std::map<std::string, std::vector<std::string>>>;
       and use it as the task return type instead of
       Mapper::get_sub_tree_t::return_type
     - the map key is std::string now (was object_path), so:
           results.emplace_back(path, service);

With both fixes the stack builds clean (spdmd + both test binaries link) and
meson test passes 2/2 on the current ubuntu-unit-test-dmtf-libspdm image.

Happy to push these two small fixes as patchsets if that's easier -- just say
the word. Thanks for driving this; looking forward to landing the
ComponentIntegrity frontend on top.

-- Gary

Patch Set 25:

Correction to my earlier comment.

Point 1 is the real and only CI failure: the undeclared 'coverage' meson option -- meson.build:97:3: ERROR: Option coverage does not exist (job 137639), which aborts meson setup before anything compiles. The fix is just adding the 'coverage' option to meson.options.

Please disregard point 2 (the get_sub_tree_t / sdbusplus "drift" + the mapper.cpp change). That was speculation from a stale vendored subprojects/sdbusplus in my local tree; CI never reaches the build phase here, and those symbols aren't removed from current sdbusplus. I've abandoned the related 91656.

Sorry for the misleading addendum -- point 1 alone is what's needed here.

@ratankgupta31@gmail.com / @hosmanechinmay@gmail.com -  Instead of adding all the stub functions at once, could we add each function together with its implementation? Reviewing this commit as-is would require us to look ahead at future commits to confirm that none of these stubs end up as dead code, which makes it difficult to track completeness later.

Merging this code without the follow-up patch would also leave the repo in a broken state functionally. @patrick@stwcx.xyz — what’s your take on this?

This file is taken from dmtf libspdm https://github.com/DMTF/libspdm/blob/main/os_stub/spdm_device_secret_lib_null/lib.c. Without spdm_device_secret_lib it does not compile, while we may need not implement all these functions in the stub and most of the implementation we plan directly to take a reference from dmtf libspdm for required modules.

Hi Ratan — I rebuilt 80267/PS26 in a current CI image (gcc-15, meson 1.10.1, sdbusplus HEAD) to chase the Verified−1, and it turns out there are two small fixes needed, not one:

1. meson.options is missing the coverage option that meson.build:97 reads via get_option('coverage'), so meson setup aborts before compiling anything (meson.build:97:3: ERROR: Option coverage does not exist, job 138552). Add:

meson
option('coverage', type: 'boolean', value: false,
       description: 'Enable the coverage-html custom target')

2. With setup fixed, the build then fails -Werror=deprecated-declarations in the Trusted Component change (80274): requester/trusted_component_dbus.hpp:45 and .cpp:18 use the now-deprecated sdbusplus::bus::bus. Fix is sdbusplus::bus::bus → sdbusplus::bus_t (both spots).

With both fixes, 80267 and the changes below it configures, compiles, links, and meson test passes 2/2 for me. I didn't rebuild the changes stacked above 80267, so there may be similar deprecated-alias cleanups needed higher up — but this clears the base.

(Also — please disregard my earlier get_sub_tree_t / mapper.cpp note; I verified it compiles fine against current sdbusplus, HEAD 542f199 still generates that alias.)

Happy to push either or both as patchsets if that's easier — just say the word. Thanks for driving this.

— Gary

Hi Chinmay — PS27 (your 12:20 rebase) is still Verified−1 on the same two issues from my earlier note: the coverage option missing from meson.options on 80267, and sdbusplus::bus::bus → sdbusplus::bus_t in requester/trusted_component_dbus.{hpp,cpp} on 80274 (-Werror=deprecated-declarations). I built both in a current CI image (gcc-15 / sdbusplus HEAD) — with them the stack configures, compiles, and meson test passes 2/2. I've got them staged and can push as patchsets onto 80267/80274, or you can fold them into your next rebase — whatever's easiest. Just let me know.
Those CI issues are fixed now.
